items.title: Is Best Buy (BBY) A Bargain On Its Debt Filing And New Partnerships?
items.summary: Best Buy (BBY) has just filed a shelf registration for debt securities, giving the retailer a flexible way to tap credit markets when it chooses to raise capital. Best Buy’s share price has eased in the past week, with a 7 day share price return of down 2.5% and a 1 day move slightly lower. However, the 30 day and 90 day share price returns of 9.8% and 16.6% suggest momentum has been building through late 2026.
